prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE finished photorealistic minimalist Earl Grey Matcha Latte catalogue photograph, portrait 3:4, ideally 1086 x 1448.
The provided image is the APPROVED MASTER: preserve its actual product, precise cup shape, branding and typography style and scale. Vary camera angle, composition and product scale meaningfully for the scene described below; do not simply reuse the exact master photograph. One short broad transparent sundae cup with clear properly seated dome lid. Preserve original girl-and-rabbit 128am Cafe sticker; bunny has exactly TWO ears. At the very bottom show a thin 4–5% liquid-height amber-brown Earl Grey syrup band, beige infused milk above, rich natural green matcha marbling, smooth creamy cold foam gently mounded inside dome with light matcha dusting. Never piped whipped cream or tall foam tower. Preserve realistic plastic refraction, gently improved exposure and appetising true colours.
Packaging must be clean: crystal-clear outer flange and lid rim, dry exterior with no overflow, green smears, external drips or residue; restrained fine condensation acceptable. Full dome, cup and bottom syrup visible with comfortable margins.
Typography exactly as master: large rounded bold Fredoka-style muted rose #B8496C lowercase "earl grey" first line and "matcha latte" second line, smaller "128am Cafe" beneath in the same font. Header centrally aligned at same scale as master with generous top space. Crisp text, no new tracking or font changes. No other text, claims, prices, watermark or badges.
STRICT MINIMALISM: one cup, one plain simple background/surface and a restrained soft shadow. NO props, tea bowls, leaves, flowers, cloth, plants, windows, furniture, objects, decor, patterns, pedestal, other drinks or additional ingredients. Photographic, never illustration/CGI.
Scene: plain desaturated light sage #E7F0DC seamless studio with matte matching surface, no horizon. IMPORTANT NEW VIEW: camera noticeably elevated 32 degrees looking down through clear dome at the creamy foam and matcha dusting. Cup still fully upright, complete front wall and bottom amber syrup band visible, no top-down crop. Cup placed LEFT of centre in lower portion, smaller at 47% image height, slightly turned so girl-and-bunny sticker is still fully visible on front. Broad directional light from upper LEFT, simple delicate shadow falling lower right. Bright gentle high-key colour, whole cup sharp. Exact header remains centrally aligned above with master font and size. Quiet refined food photograph, no props and no background shapes.
